read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, source registers and capability declaration
input: USFS FSim conditional flame-length class, exact integer 1 to 6 (0 = no event), or the six-class probability vector; no interpolation; burn probability stays with Hazard
not_covered: Replacement support and fieldwork: no own curve; allocated once at the aggregate direct-and-civil damage ratio (T4 rule)
out_of_scope: Power shutoffs, downtime, business interruption and insurance terms
Post-fire erosion or landslide, environmental remediation and fire-service liability
Soft and non-physical cost (installed capex above physical replacement value)
missing_mechanisms: Smoke and ash optical losses and module cleaning

how_to_use.share_of: Pre-event direct replacement value of the same part; the plant view uses the named reference profile WILDFIRE_SOLAR_REFERENCE_100MWDC_V1 or complete site part values

outputs.single_event: allowed: per-part damage ratio for one exact class, or the expected ratio over the six-class probabilities
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: needs an explicit value profile or complete site part values
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: computed by the consumer with FSim burn probability in the frequency layer and cap-binding checks passed; curve spread not carried

conditions: Only exact integer classes 0 to 6; no interpolation or extrapolation
Six-class probabilities must each lie in [0, 1] and sum to one
Burn probability is not allowed in the damage call
Outputs carry screening flags: not field or claims calibrated; FSim class is not local heat flux

method.summary: Exact-class state tables per part on FSim flame-length classes; ordering constrained by field, lab and guidance sources, absolute values set by engineering judgment

key_sources: USDA Forest Service, Spatial datasets of probabilistic wildfire risk components for the US, 3rd ed., RDS-2016-0034-3 (USFS_FSIM_RDS_2023)
DOE/FEMP, Solar Photovoltaic Hardening for Resilience - Wildfire (DOE_FEMP_PV_WILDFIRE)
NEMA GD 2-2016, Evaluating Fire- and Heat-Damaged Electrical Equipment (NEMA_GD2_2016)
FM, Data Sheet 7-106: Ground-Mounted Solar Power, April 2026 (FM_DS_7_106_2026)
NREL/NLR, Q1-2025 Solar PV System Cost Benchmarks (NREL_NLR_Q1_2025_PV_BENCHMARK)
judgment: Damage values per flame-length class for every part are engineering judgment (no class-specific field data)
Racking, foundations and grounding get a low response, not immunity
Support cost is allocated in proportion to direct-and-civil damage

checks.name: Financial range check (Hazard repo): industry loss figures for solar wildfire

open_items: No field or claims calibration; values to be replaced when paired exposure, disposition and cost evidence arrives
No credit yet for site controls (vegetation, barriers, suppression, de-energisation); kept as metadata
Reference profile counts all cable as exposed and the mixed civil row as direct civil; site schedules should replace it
